researchgate_paraguay_guarani_papers.keywords: Guarani-Jopara, large language model, low-resource NLP, code-switching
researchgate_paraguay_guarani_papers.abstract_summary: Analyzes the feasibility and limitations of adapting LLMs to under-resourced languages. Built a Guarani-Jopara LLM baseline. Identifies challenges: (1) representing hybrid morphology, (2) code-switching patterns, (3) tokenization. Contributes new datasets, analytical insights, culturally informed evaluation methods.
